5742.title: Windows file-manager path serialization
5742.rootCauseOneLine: The Windows file-manager launcher passes portable slash-delimited paths to Explorer without native-path conversion.
5742.proposedFix: Normalize the Windows file-manager path at the OS invocation boundary, preserving environment-based argument handling.
5742.caveats: Reproduced at command construction on Linux in two trusted checkouts; native Windows Explorer UI behavior was not executed.
